claims.exact_source_evidence:
export const _safeParse: (_Err: $ZodErrorClass) => $SafeParse = (_Err) => (schema, value, _ctx) => {
  const ctx: schemas.ParseContextInternal = _ctx ? { ..._ctx, async: false } : { async: false };

expected_interpretation.en: The synchronous returned arrow creates ctx with async: false.
expected_interpretation.pt-BR: A arrow síncrona retornada cria ctx com async: false.

generated_en.text: The synchronous returned arrow sets the async flag to false.

generated_pt_BR.text: A setagem assíncrona do arrow retornado sincrônico é falsa.

claims.reason: False async flag correct; PT descriptor awkward but flag identity in question context retained.

claims.exact_source_evidence: const result = schema._zod.run({ value, issues: [] }, ctx);

expected_interpretation.en: The synchronous arrow calls schema._zod.run with { value, issues: [] } and ctx.
expected_interpretation.pt-BR: A arrow síncrona chama schema._zod.run com { value, issues: [] } e ctx.

generated_en.text: The synchronous arrow calls the schema runner with the value and issues.

generated_pt_BR.text: O arrow sincrônico chama o runner de esquema com o valor e as issues.

claims.reason: Payload object plus ctx argument roles not conveyed.

expected_interpretation.en: The synchronous arrow explicitly throws core.$ZodAsyncError under result instanceof Promise.
expected_interpretation.pt-BR: A arrow síncrona lança explicitamente core.$ZodAsyncError sob result instanceof Promise.

generated_en.text: The synchronous Promise guard throws a $ZodAsyncError.

generated_pt_BR.text: O guardiano de promise sincrônico lança uma $ZodAsyncError.

claims.exact_source_evidence: return result.issues.length ? failure(_Err, result.issues, ctx) : ({ success: true, data: result.value } as any);

expected_interpretation.en: At the normal return, truthy result.issues.length selects failure.

generated_en.text: The condition that selects the normal failure branch is when the issues array is not empty.

generated_pt_BR.text: A condição que seleciona a branch de falha normal é quando a array de issues não está vazia.

claims.exact_source_evidence: return result.issues.length ? failure(_Err, result.issues, ctx) : ({ success: true, data: result.value } as any);

expected_interpretation.en: At the normal return with no issues, the literal has success: true.

expected_interpretation.en: The error getter construction branch is guarded by !error.

generated_en.text: The error getter guards construction by checking if the error is undefined.

generated_pt_BR.text: O getter de erro protege a construção guardando se o erro é indefinido.

claims.reason: Actual guard !closure-local error is truthiness, not an undefined-only test.

expected_interpretation.en: The error setter assigns e to the local error.
expected_interpretation.pt-BR: O setter de error atribui e à variável local error.

generated_en.text: The error setter assigns the local error to the `error` property.

generated_pt_BR.text: A atribuição do erro local ao propriedade `error`.

claims.reason: Generated local error->error property is not incoming setter e->closure-local error; assignment direction/ownership wrong.

expected_interpretation.en: The asynchronous arrow awaits result when result instanceof Promise.
expected_interpretation.pt-BR: A arrow assíncrona aguarda result quando result instanceof Promise.

generated_en.text: The asynchronous arrow waits for the result to resolve when it is a promise.

generated_pt_BR.text: O arrow assíncrono espera para a resolução do resultado quando ele é uma promise.

claims.reason: Await under Promise guard conveyed; no always-fulfills promise inferred.

expected_interpretation.en: The core safeParse binding supplies errors.$ZodRealError to _safeParse.
